checks: BLE management requires administrator access
Employee credentials cannot administer BLE or impersonate a receiver
Receiver configuration validates reader ID and device token
Unknown tag diagnostics retain capture/receipt times and acknowledge retries once
Unassigned hardware appears for administrator binding without selecting an employee
Binding is normalized, exclusive and does not rewrite unknown historical scans
Without NFC arrival, assigned tags remain disabled and raw events have no employee identity
Official NFC arrival opens BLE configuration with an explicit tracking deadline
Administrator grace setting is editable and constrained to 60–600 seconds
Invalid credentials, addresses, event IDs, RSSI, future clocks and oversized batches are rejected
Captured BLE timeline uses reader branch and counts explicit loss once without adding a second grace
Faults, recovery without a fresh tag reading and stale receiver periods remain unknown inside card sessions
Fresh connected-tag observation appears live and repeated upload is idempotent
Reader fault overrides tag state and recovery requires a fresh explicit observation
Reboot cannot reuse observations from the previous receiver boot
Receiver/network heartbeat loss becomes unknown rather than inferred absence
Maximum tracking cap disables BLE tracking without manufacturing an NFC checkout
NFC checkout stops interpretation and subsequent diagnostics cannot extend employee hours
Reassignment preserves capture-time ownership for delayed offline events
Administrator period and page validation prevents invalid reports
BLE creates no attendance actions, GPS logs or wage deductions
